video_title: Melo & Kaz HEATED 50 Cent Super Bowl Debate After Jay-Z Reportedly Picks Himself

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony questions if 50 Cent can headline the Super Bowl
quotes.excerpt: Do you believe that 50 Cent could do the Super Bowl by himself?

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: Do you believe that 50 Cent could do the Super Bowl by himself?

text_blocks.speaker: Kazeem Famuyide
text_blocks.text: I don't think he'd ever do the Super Bowl by himself. I think he has the catalog to do it, I don't know if he has the performance to do it.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony outlines his vision for a 50 Cent Super Bowl performance
quotes.excerpt: I'm bringing Justin Timberlake out, I'm bringing Akon, I'm bringing Eminem, I'm bringing all these motherfuckers.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: If I'm him and I'm doing the Super Bowl, I'm bringing Justin Timberlake out, I'm bringing Akon, I'm bringing Eminem, I'm bringing all these motherfuckers. It's my Super Bowl show.

text_blocks.speaker: Kazeem Famuyide
text_blocks.text: If 50 Cent goes on tour today, is he doing stadiums? Is he doing MSG? Is he doing Barclays? It's a simple question.
